bear_assumptions: EUR 10.00 normalized forward adjusted EPS at 19x as data-centre systems growth normalizes, mix and input costs pressure margins, working capital stays elevated, and acquisition-related net debt restrains the multiple.
base_assumptions: EUR 10.00 normalized forward adjusted EPS at 24x as 10-13% organic revenue growth and operating leverage partly offset systems mix, working capital, Cognite funding, and a premium starting valuation.
bull_assumptions: EUR 10.65 normalized forward adjusted EPS at 31x as data-centre demand and backlog convert broadly, Energy Management sustains strong margins, recurring software and services accelerate, and acquisitions preserve per-share returns.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh mark restores required expected return, base upside, downside payoff and margin of safety while data-centre demand converts to cash without rising concentration, working capital or leverage; downgrade on project delays or cancellations, systems-mix margin erosion, weak H2 cash conversion, acquisition dilution, materially higher net debt, supply disruption, or demand and backlog normalization below guidance.
